passage:
A delivery rider showed students how he used a map app to choose routes. The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.
He knew which streets flooded after rain, which elevators were slow, and which apartment gates were hard to find. Sometimes the app's shortest route was not the best route.
Students were surprised. They thought technology made all decisions.
The rider said, "The map is useful, but it does not feel the road."
The lesson stayed with them. Data can guide people, but experience still matters. A smart worker learns from both the screen and the street.
